description: Classified by reading packages/server/src/providers/codex.ts. Client requests come from the stable schema; notifications and server requests include experimental ones because casm initializes with experimentalApi: true.

input:mention.note: agent.send is text only; no structured @mentions (history shows @name).

input:skill.note: agent.send is text only; no structured skill invocation (history shows @name).

item:collabAgentToolCall.note: Subagent calls as a tool; subagent threads themselves are filtered out.

item:commandExecution.note: name shell; output is the aggregated output.

item:fileChange.note: name edit; output is the concatenated diffs (no structured diff).

item:hookPrompt.note: Hook-injected prompts are dropped from the transcript.

item:imageGeneration.note: Falls through to a generic tool item; the generated image is not shown.

item:imageView.note: The viewed image itself is not shown.

item:plan.note: Shown as plain assistant text, not as a structured plan.

item:sleep.note: Falls through to the generic tool mapping.

item:userMessage.note: History only; live prompts are emitted by casm. Mentions/skills become @name, other inputs [type].
